items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: joined Woody’s band right after he got out of the Navy

ctx.x: 4F, if you were 4F, yeah. See at that time we were all — now Gozzo, two or three guys from Claude’s band got into the Artie Shaw Navy band and they didn’t have it easy, they were in the Pacific being shot at you know. But they survived. What a reunion — he

joined Woody’s band right after he got out of the Navy, and I joined this McKinley band and we were working the Commodore Hotel and they came in town to play the Paramount. Their band finished early, they call came over where we were, what a reunion.
I guess, wow. Wish to have that on film.
